description: Frost, flood and thunder - a caster who drowns the field and turns Intellect into speed.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 36 real CoA Maelstrom talents (role DPS), completing Stormbringer - the worst-measuring class of the 15 that remained, at 89.6% scalar-only. Whirling Maelstrom ports whole (haste from intellect is a legal conversion pair). CONDUCTIVE, CoA's second stacking resource, cannot exist: six talents read its stack count and nothing reads another effect's stack count, and CoA's own Conductive description is the unresolved token '$56'. All six are granted flat at their ceiling. The old tree's four unlock nodes were all for non-gated abilities and did nothing; replaced with real mechanics.

nodes.name: Whirling Maelstrom
nodes.description: Increases your spell haste by 20% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 20 Passive. Increases your spell haste by 20% of your Intellect.' PORTS WHOLE - haste is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and intellect in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, so this is a legal pair and CoA's 20% is kept exactly. It is a FRACTION. A caster whose primary stat buys turn speed is the spec's whole identity, the same shape as the Witch Doctor's three Spirit conversions.

nodes.name: Cloudsurfer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shock by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Shock by 20%.' Ports exactly. Shock is the spec's Static builder, so this is its filler node.

nodes.name: Torrential Rage
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Torrential Wrath and Stormflow by 16.2%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Torrential Wrath and Stormflow by 15%.' Doubled for the two ranks and authored as the full-investment ceiling. Both abilities exist in Frontier.

nodes.name: Disciple of Thorim
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 3 ranks: 'Reduces the cast time of your Torrential Wrath by 0.2 sec and increases your hit chance by 2%.' There are no cast times, so only the hit half survives. Authored at CoA's own PER-RANK 2% with CoA's 3 ranks, which reaches 6% at full investment - get_effective_effects() multiplies by points spent, so the per-rank value is what goes in the file and the description states the ceiling. Authoring 6.0 here with ranks=3 would have delivered 18%, which is the bug that shipped on Guardian Vanguard's Iron Guardian earlier today.

nodes.name: Hydro Powered
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Standardised 6 Nov: every caster tree carries one 5-point spell-crit-damage talent worth +100% at full rank, matching priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury (both WoW-accurate). Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.'

nodes.name: Prodigy of Lei Shen
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Stormflow by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Allows your Stormflow to critically strike.' There is no per-ability 'can crit' flag - every ability can crit here - so the talent has nothing to switch on. Rerouted to crit chance on the same ability, which is what CoA's version delivers in practice: Stormflow crits where it did not before.

nodes.name: Blessing of Lei Shen
nodes.description: Stormflow heals you for 25% of the damage it deals.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Stormflow now heals you equal to the damage dealt.' leech_pct is a live payload and reads the triggering hit's amount, so this is one of the few CoA talents whose scaling CAN be expressed. Priced at 25% rather than CoA's 100%: full leech on a channelled nuke would make the spec unkillable in a turn-based fight, where a channel resolves as a single cast rather than ticking against incoming damage. FRACTION.

nodes.name: Undertow
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Drown by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Drown by 25%.' Doubled for the two ranks.

nodes.name: Raining and Pouring
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of Torrential Wrath and Electrocute by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical damage of your Torrential Wrath and Electrocute by 30%.' Ports exactly. ability_*_crit_damage is a FRACTION, while ability_*_crit on the two nodes beside it is a PERCENT - the same tree carries both.

nodes.name: Conduit
nodes.description: Your frost spells leave the target taking 4% more spell damage per stack for 3 turns, stacking 4 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Dealing Frost damage now has a 60% chance to increase the damage the target takes from Electrocute by 15% for 10 sec, stacking up to 4 times.' THERE IS NO TRIGGER-SIDE DAMAGE-SCHOOL FILTER - proc['school'] only types a damage_flat payload - so 'dealing Frost damage' becomes an ability_filter on the spec's frost kit. And no key makes a target take more damage from ONE named ability, so it becomes spell damage taken generally, priced down from 15% to 4% per stack because it now boosts everything rather than Electrocute alone. CoA's 60% chance and 4 stacks kept; 10 sec is 3 turns.

nodes.name: Washed Away
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Drown by 35%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of Drown by -15 sec.' Expressed as a percentage because CoA's 15 seconds is measured against a 1-minute cooldown that does not exist in those units here. POSITIVE reduces, so CoA's minus sign is dropped.

nodes.name: Flow of Wrath
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 15% against enemies affected by Drown.' No effect key reads whether a target carries a debuff, so the condition is dropped and CoA's 15% applies always. Drown is a 1-minute cooldown rather than a rotational debuff, so this IS a real buff over CoA's version rather than a formality - stated rather than hidden, and it sits at tier 2 accordingly.

nodes.name: Voltaic Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Deluge by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Deluge is increased by 5% for each stack of Conductive.' CONDUCTIVE CANNOT EXIST - nothing reads another effect's stack count, and CoA's own Conductive description is the unresolved token '$56', so even its cap is unknown. Five stacks at 5% is the standard assumption across CoA's stacking buffs, giving 25% flat.

nodes.name: Kinetic Energy
nodes.description: Your spells charge you, raising your spell critical strike chance by 2% per stack for 3 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting a spell that consumes Conductive now grants you a stack of Kinetic Energy. Critical strike chance increased by 2%, stacking 3 times, for 10 sec. Additional applications do not refresh the duration.' The Conductive condition cannot be read, so it fires on any damage cast. CoA's 2% and 3 stacks kept, 10 sec is 3 turns. The no-refresh rule has no equivalent - re-application always refreshes here - which makes this slightly stronger than CoA's.

nodes.name: Lethal Current
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Electrocute by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Electrocute by 30% against enemies below 20% health.' THERE IS NO EXECUTE GATE AVAILABLE TO A TALENT - execute_threshold is an ABILITY property and high_health_damage_threshold_pct is a dead key - so the condition cannot be expressed. Priced at 25% total rather than CoA's 60% over two ranks, because it now applies at every health level instead of only the last fifth.

nodes.name: Bursting
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Drown by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the stack value of Drowning by 20%.' Drowning is Drown's own stacking mechanic (CoA: 'each time you generate a stack of Conductive you increase their...' - the text is truncated in the Builder payload itself), and no key modifies another effect's per-stack value. Rerouted to the ability's damage, which is what a bigger stack value buys.

nodes.name: Unbridled Flow
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shock by a further 15%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Damage dealt by Shock is now increased by 15% while channeling Stormflow.' THERE IS NO CHANNELLING - a cast resolves within a turn - so the gate cannot exist. CoA's 15% is granted permanently. This is the first of three talents whose whole condition is 'while channeling Stormflow' (with Storm Synergy and Amped Flow); Storm Synergy is not built at all, since 'Electrocute can be used while channeling' has nothing left once channelling is gone.

nodes.name: Amped Flow
nodes.description: Shock splashes 75% of its damage onto 1 nearby enemy.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'While channeling Stormflow, your Shock now strikes 1 additional target at 75% value.' The channel gate is gone (see Unbridled Flow) but the rest ports closely - CoA's 1 extra target at exactly 75% value, as splash_damage, since no key adds targets to an ability. One of the cleaner translations in this tree because CoA already stated it as a percentage.

nodes.name: Unstable
nodes.description: Your critical strikes quicken the flow, raising your haste by 15% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your direct damage critical strikes cause your Stormflow to tick 20% faster for 3 sec.' A faster tick has no meaning when ticks are per-turn, and nothing modifies one ability's tick rate. Rerouted to haste, which is what 'faster' means in a turn-based fight - acting more often. 1-turn internal cooldown so a crit streak does not hold it up permanently.

nodes.name: Stormcloud
nodes.description: Torrential Wrath gathers a cloud overhead, leaving the target taking 20% more spell damage for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Summon a cloud above an enemy target's head for 15 sec, causing them to take 20% additional damage from your spells. Using Torrential Wrath on an enemy affected by Stormcloud causes a Geyser to erupt beneath them.' The first half ports exactly - CoA's 20%, and 15 sec is 5 turns. The Geyser needs a debuff-presence check, which no key provides, so the follow-up eruption is dropped. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT spell_damage_taken_pct is divided by 100 and POSITIVE INCREASES damage taken, which is what a debuff wants.

nodes.name: Hydromatic
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Electrocute by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 50 passive: 'Your Electrocute is now affected by Conductive, increasing its damage by 10% per stack.' Conductive cannot exist (see Voltaic Mastery). Five stacks at 10% is 50% flat - the ceiling a fully-stacked Maelstrom would have reached.

nodes.name: Conductor In Charge
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3% and your Frost damage dealt by 5%. Does not stack with similar effects.' A TALENT CANNOT REACH AN ALLY - get_talent_effects() reads only the character's own trees - and there is no per-school damage key for the Frost half. Both halves land on the Stormbringer as a single 8% (CoA's 3 plus 5), and the description says 'you' rather than promising a raid buff the engine will not deliver. Contrast Wind, where the party buffs are real because they are ABILITIES.

nodes.name: Static Electricity
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Torrential Wrath bring Drown two turns closer to ready.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Torrential Wrath now spawn an Electrified Water Elemental to aid you in combat for 20 sec. When an Electrified Water Elemental dissipates, the cooldown of your Drown is reduced by -2 sec.' A talent cannot summon a pet - there is no summon payload, and Stormbringer's only pet is the Air Elemental on the Wind tree - and no trigger fires when a pet dies. So the elemental is cut and its PURPOSE is kept: the Drown cooldown reduction, delivered directly off the crit that would have spawned it. CoA's Electrified Waters node is the same mechanic keyed on Drown being up and is folded in here rather than built twice.

nodes.name: Spheres of Power
nodes.description: Your spells have a 25% chance to loose a power sphere, striking for spellstorm damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your direct damage dealt now has a 25% chance to summon a Power Sphere that will move towards your target. Can only have 1 Power Sphere up at a time. Power Sphere will redirect its movement towards enemies you cast Stormflow on. Upon reaching the target, it deals Spellstorm Damage to them and enemies within 5 yds.' A travelling projectile is positional and there is no summon payload, so the sphere becomes the damage it would have delivered, immediately. CoA's 25% kept. Spellstorm is typed arcane, the engine's generic magic school.

nodes.name: Mystic Thunder
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Torrential Wrath by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Interrupt the target's current spell cast and then mark them for 5 seconds. If they cast again while marked they are silenced for 3 seconds.' NEITHER INTERRUPT NOR SILENCE HAS A KEY, and a mark read by a later action needs a debuff-presence check that does not exist - so none of this talent is buildable as written. It is the second node in this audit to lose everything to the missing silence key (after Lightning's Tome of Lightning). Rerouted to damage on the spec's Static spender so the node is worth a point.

nodes.name: Stormfury
nodes.description: Your spells call down the storm, striking for nature damage and leaving the sky raining on your target for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Depletes 50 Static. Summon a flurry of rain, wind, and lightning from the sky for 20 seconds. Every 2 sec, enemies within 30 yds of the caster are zapped with lightning, dealing Nature damage.' A persistent area effect centred on the caster has no mechanism - there is no ground placement and no periodic trigger - so the capstone pays the same damage two ways instead: an immediate strike plus a dot, both off the frost kit, with a 1-turn internal cooldown so casting two frost spells in a turn does not double it. This is the one payload combination that gets close to 'a storm that keeps hitting', and both halves are live: damage_flat with a school, and apply_effect carrying a dot.
